name: Creality Falcon2 22W
tagline: 22W Entry Creality diode — simple upgrade path for 3D printer owners
tldr: Creality Falcon2 22W is the 22W SKU on the Creality creality falcon2 line. The base Falcon2 12W is Creality's affordable open-frame diode. Verify optical power on the listing — do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Versatile hobby engraving with solid cutting through typical 3–6 mm basswood

priceRange.note: 22W optical module — verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Low entry price from known brand
cons: Weak vs 20W competitors at similar total cost
Creality laser software less mature than xTool
beginnerNotes: Choose 22W if it matches your typical jobs. Compare cut depth and price against other tiers in this product line before ordering.
proTips: Run slower on fills for cleaner results — 12W needs patience. Upgrade to 22W module later if Creality offers it for your frame.
primaryUse: Budget engraving-focused diode for Creality ecosystem users and light hobby personalization.
